reason: Health rule (borderline): her own site (gracequantumhealing.com) presents her Quantum-Touch results in terms of conditions (her About section names dementia, anxiety, depression, scoliosis, lymphoma, high blood pressure, fibroids and allergies), and every session and workshop product page carries the same text on bones sliding into alignment, pain and inflammation, chiropractic and breast-cancer surgery.
